ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
en: (1) Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."
tr: Innā arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihī an andhir qawmaka min qabli ay yaʾtiyahum ʿadhābun alīm

ar: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
en: (2) He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner -
tr: Qāla yāqawmi innī lakum nadhīrum mubīn

ar: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
en: (3) To worship Allāh, fear Him and obey me.
tr: Aniʿbudullāha wattaqūhu waʾaṭīʿūn

ar: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
en: (4) He [i.e., Allāh] will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allāh, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew."
tr: Yaghfir lakum min dhunūbikum wayuʾakhkhirkum ilā ajalim musammā, inna ajalallāhi idhā jāʾa lā yuʾakhkhar, law kuntum taʿlamūn

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
en: (5) He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.
tr: Qāla rabbi innī daʿawtu qawmī laylaw wanahārā

ar: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
en: (6) But my invitation increased them not except in flight [i.e., aversion].
tr: Falam yazidhum duʿāʾī illā firārā

ar: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا
en: (7) And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments,[1761] persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.
tr: Waʾinnī kullamā daʿawtuhum litaghfira lahum jaʿalū aṣābiʿahum fī ādhānihim wastaghshaw thiyābahum waʾaṣarrū wastakbarustikbārā

ar: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا
en: (8) Then I invited them publicly.
tr: Thumma innī daʿawtuhum jihārā

ar: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
en: (9) Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly
tr: Thumma innī aʿlantu lahum waʾasrartu lahum isrārā

ar: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
en: (10) And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
tr: Faqultustaghfirū rabbakum innahū kāna ghaffārā

ar: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا
en: (11) He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
tr: Yursilis-samāʾa ʿalaykum midrārā

ar: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَٰرًا
en: (12) And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.
tr: Wayumdidkum biʾamwāliw wabanīna wayajʿal lakum jannātiw wayajʿal lakum anhārā

ar: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
en: (13) What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allāh [due] grandeur
tr: Mā lakum lā tarjūna lillāhi waqārā

ar: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
en: (14) While He has created you in stages?[1762]
enNotes: [1762]- i.e., in various progressive states and conditions. See also 22:5 and 23:12-14 in reference to development of the embryo.
tr: Waqad khalaqakum aṭwārā

ar: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا
en: (15) Do you not consider how Allāh has created seven heavens in layers[1763]
tr: Alam taraw kayfa khalaqallāhu sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqā

ar: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
en: (16) And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?
tr: Wajaʿalal-qamara fīhinna nūraw wajaʿalash-shamsa sirājā

ar: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
en: (17) And Allāh has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.
tr: Wallāhu ambatakum minal-arḍi nabātā

ar: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
en: (18) Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.
tr: Thumma yuʿīdukum fīhā wayukhrijukum ikhrājā

ar: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا
en: (19) And Allāh has made for you the earth an expanse
tr: Wallāhu jaʿala lakumul-arḍa bisāṭā

ar: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا
en: (20) That you may follow therein roads of passage.'"
tr: Litaslukū minhā subulan fijājā

ar: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
en: (21) Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.
tr: Qāla nūḥur rabbi innahum ʿaṣawnī wattabaʿū mal lam yazidhu māluhū wawaladuhū illā khasārā

ar: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا
en: (22) And they conspired an immense conspiracy
tr: Wamakarū makran kubbārā

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا
en: (23) And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwāʿ or Yaghūth and Yaʿūq and Nasr.'[1764]
enNotes: [1764]- These were the names of specific idols named after pious men of earlier generations.
tr: Waqālū lā tadharunna ālihatakum walā tadharunna waddaw walā suwāʿaw walā yaghūtha wayaʿūqa wanasrā

ar: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلًا
en: (24) And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."
tr: Waqad aḍallū kathīrā, walā tazidiẓ-ẓālimīna illā ḍalālā

ar: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًا
en: (25) Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers.
tr: Mimmā khaṭīʾātihim ughriqū faʾudkhilū nāran falam yajidū lahum min dūnillāhi anṣārā

ar: وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
en: (26) And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.
tr: Waqāla nūḥur rabbi lā tadhar ʿalal-arḍi minal-kāfirīna dayyārā

ar: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا
en: (27) Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.
tr: Innaka in tadharhum yuḍillū ʿibādaka walā yalidū illā fājiran kaffārā

ar: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا
en: (28) My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
tr: Rabbighfir lī waliwālidayya waliman dakhala baytiya muʾminaw walilmuʾminīna wal-muʾmināt, walā tazidiẓ-ẓālimīna illā tabārā
